entities.name: Query ThiI sulfurtransferase
observations: 485 aa sequence; predicted mass 54,884.5 Da and theoretical pI 5.743.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial ThiI/tRNA sulfurtransferase: closest cited match A4XZX0 has 81.0% identity and 100% query coverage (E=1.12e-284).
ThiI homolog annotation: ATP-dependent sulfur transfer supports tRNA 4-thiouridine (s4U) formation and ThiS thiocarboxylation; sulfur is supplied as persulfide by IscS.
Homolog annotations place ThiI in the cytoplasm and associate it with thiamine diphosphate/thiazole biosynthesis; these are homology-based assignments for this sequence.
Reference homolog features include THUMP domain and C-terminal rhodanese domain; active-site persulfide cysteine is at homolog position 457, not independently position-mapped onto query.
